name: Boiling Fountains
source: Pathfinder #157: Devil at the Dreaming Palace
description: Four pressure plates beneath the floorboards activate dragon-headed fountains on either side of the room, which spray boiling water across the area between them.
disable: DC 21 Thievery check (trained) to disable each pressure plate, DC 16 Thievery check to jam each fountain, or DC 18 Thievery check to deflect a fountain's spray
reset: Once a pressure plate has been activated, it must be reset manually.

offensiveAbilities.name: Scalding Spray
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger Weight is placed on one of the squares marked with "T" on the map, triggering a pressure plate

Effect The fountains spray boiling water across their own squares and the 10-foot-by-20-foot area between them (marked with dotted lines), dealing 4d6+4 fire damage to any creatures in the area (DC 22 basic Reflex save).
